content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On sales invoice:new, the first click on the Effective Value Date input does not seem to start text entry. In all three windows the user clicks the field, then clicks it again about 4\u20135 s later, and the first keystroke follows that second click within 15\u201323 ms.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, check the focus and click handlers on the Effective Value Date input (for example, a date picker that opens or closes on focus or click) so that one click leaves the input focused and accepting keystrokes; then confirm in a test that a single click followed by typing produces input_activity without a second click.", "cited_event_ids": ["277", "280", "287", "290", "283", "293", "284", "291", "295"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The windows contain no picker, tooltip, overlay, or validation events near the Effective Value Date input, so the mechanism behind the first click not enabling entry is not visible.", "The events do not show why users paused; the pause may be reading or hesitation, which the events cannot show.", "Coverage is empty, so no overlay on the field is confirmed.", "Typed values are masked, so it is unknown whether the keystrokes after the second click were accepted into the field.", "The 2.0 s median loss and the 4.0\u20135.6 s pause range come from the insight facts and were not recomputed."]}
